name: engineering-agent-skills
description: Independent project bootstrap for new/existing codebases and integrated verification/release for single- or multi-Git products.

interface.shortDescription: Source-first project bootstrap and optional integration/release governance
interface.longDescription: project-bootstrap supports new projects or existing source-first adoption, producing evidence-backed confirmed requirements and technical constraints, AGENTS.md, and on-demand approved rules. engineering-governance provides optional integrated verification and reproducible releases. The active agent executes engineering tasks directly; Grill and Wayfinder may clarify major unresolved decisions.
defaultPrompt: Use project-bootstrap to initialize a new project from confirmed goals and constraints without inventing a codebase.
Use project-bootstrap to inspect this existing source project and establish evidenced, confirmed requirements and technical-constraints documents.
Use project-bootstrap add-rule to maintain approved, evidenced rules inside .agents/rules/ without editing AGENTS.md.
Use engineering-governance verify for system-level integration evidence.
Use engineering-governance release for the verified single-Git or multi-Git product revision(s).
